'''Lasha Bindari''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked for [[Shalera]] the Hutt and could be found in a [[Kor Vella Cantina|cantina]] in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
